evidence.title: CSS Scan - The fastest and easiest way to check and copy CSS

name: CSS Scan
summary: Browser extension that shows and copies the CSS of any element you hover over.
description: Extension for Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge that inspects the CSS of any element on any site and copies all active rules, child elements, pseudo-classes and media queries in one click. It can export elements to CodePen, convert CSS to Tailwind and pin the inspector on screen; sold as a buy-once lifetime license. The site also hosts free CSS example pages (buttons, checkboxes, radios, shapes, box shadows).
contains: browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge
copies full CSS rules, child elements, pseudo-classes and media queries
export elements to CodePen; convert CSS to Tailwind CSS
free CSS example pages: buttons, checkboxes, radios, shapes, box shadows
